tasting_notes: Flagship Stumbras vodka, introduced for the distillery's 100-year anniversary (Centenary); mild aroma, crystal clear, with a matured stalk of wheat placed by hand in each bottle. This is the Stumbras SKU eligible for the 'Original Lithuanian vodka' (Originali lietuviska degtine) GI, registered exclusively to Stumbras. 40% vol.
Smooth, pure grain vodka made by classical production methods unchanged since 1906; for those who appreciate the classic taste.
First organic vodka made in Lithuania; grain spirit from organically-farmed wheat, deep subsurface water and filtration through a linen filter. 40% vol.
DISTINCT line; light and delicate, ultra-pure 5-times-distilled vodka from carefully selected winter wheat.
DISTINCT line; naturally gluten-free, 8-times-distilled vodka crafted from selected young potatoes; earthy yet fresh and clean.
Flavoured vodka with ripe cranberry juice and whole berries; vibrant color, refreshing tanginess. ABV not stated on page; assumed 40% per Stumbras standard line - flag for verification.
Flavoured vodka with quince juice and fruit pieces; refreshing tanginess, soft golden color. ABV not stated on page; assumed 40% - flag for verification.
Flavoured vodka with whole raspberries hand-implanted into each bottle plus raspberry juice; sweet aroma, intense red-pink color. ABV not stated on page; assumed 40% - flag for verification.
